items.title: British-Iranian man arrested under terror laws over RAF Fairford incident
items.description: Sixth arrest comes after prime minister says there is ‘strong indications’ of Tehran’s involvement

items.title: Ex-HSBC banker banned for dodging £5,900 in train fares
items.description: Joseph Molloy was convicted this year of using a ‘doughnutting’ scam to avoid paying for tickets

items.title: Europe should take Trump’s diesel ban seriously, if not literally
items.description: Even if the president backs down, his threat should prompt Europe to be more energy independent

items.title: Burnham criticised over support for Manchester City owners
items.description: Prime minister praised City Football Group, controlled by Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed al-Nahyan, for its part in building modern Manchester

items.title: France meets fiscal reality with a crunch
items.description: A surge in borrowing costs leaves the country on the edge of a debt spiral

items.title: Train driver accelerated through red signal before fatal crash
items.description: Investigators say ‘black box’ showed Shaun Burton acknowledged automated alert ahead of Bedfordshire collision

items.title: BT seeks government nod for potential TalkTalk takeover
items.description: Telecoms group holds talks with UK officials over possible antitrust issues involved in buying smaller competitor

items.title: Dealmakers line up to test EU’s appetite to create European champions
items.description: As Brussels opens the door to bigger deals within industries, companies look for a test case of the new approach

items.title: US Sanctions A7, a Russia Firm That Helps Sidestep Economic Restrictions
items.description: The move follows recent reports detailing how A7, a Russian financial firm, used shell companies around the world to move funds on behalf of restricted Russian businesses.

items.title: Most American Children Are Being Auto-Enrolled in Trump Accounts. What to Know.
items.description: The Trump administration may have just signed up your child — and more than 60 million others — for a 530A savings account (if you haven’t already done so).

items.title: Swedish Company Uses A.I. Likeness of Greta Garbo in Ad
items.description: An ad produced by the manufacturing company SKF Group featured a digital version of the Swedish American actress, who died in 1990. Not all viewers found the replica convincing.

items.title: As Mortgage Rates Hit Highest Level Since 2023, Buyers Look at ARMs
items.description: The average 30-year, fixed-rate home loan rose to 7.28 percent, up from 6.34 percent a year ago. More buyers are now turning to adjustable-rate mortgages.

items.title: Trump’s Threat to Ban Diesel Exports Sets Off Global Alarms
items.description: A reduction in refineries has already driven the price of diesel to record highs, threatening economies. An U.S. export ban would be “tremendous shock and blow.”

items.title: Federal Watchdog Investigates Adam Kinzinger for Kalshi Bets on His Pardon
items.description: The inquiry by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission centers on bets the former congressman made on Kalshi in the weeks before he was pardoned in January 2025.

items.title: U.S. Bond Yields Hit Highest Level Since 2002
items.description: The higher yields, which are pressuring consumer and corporate borrowers and increasingly weighing on certain corners of the stock market, are unlikely to dissipate soon.

items.title: The Global Bond Rout Reaches Worrying New Levels
items.description: Investors are on alert as the yield on the 10-year Treasury note hit a new multi-decade high. The sell-off is also broadening in Europe, too.
